content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Wander the stalls where chefs and locals haggle over exotic produce and fresh seafood."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Stroll the leafy streets of Roma Norte, where old mansions and street art frame every corner."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Step into Frida's blue world, where every room hums with her fierce, tender spirit."},{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the stalls for tostadas, tropical fruit and the easy chatter of Coyoacán life."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"The heart of the old city, where the flag comes down and the stones remember everything."},{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A marble palace of murals and art deco curves, worth a slow look before it closes."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Aztec ruins right beside the cathedral, with a museum that whispers the city's first story."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"The Aztec Sun Stone alone is worth the visit, and the courtyard's umbrella fountain is a quiet marvel."},{"poi_id":"p20","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Halal comfort food with warm Moorish touches, close enough to keep the history buzz going."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Climb the hill for the castle's murals and the sweeping view over the park and Paseo de la Reforma."},{"poi_id":"p11","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Masked heroes, wild acrobatics and a roaring crowd make this the most theatrical night in town."}]}
A whole week of Mexico City, from the sacred centre to the pyramids and back through art, markets and Roma wanderings — every must-do made it in.
